description: opens a URL or search phrase in the Windows browser, via the existing launcher ladder
notes: Drives adws/adw_browser_open.py, which reuses adw_modules/map_open.py's launcher ladder and launch() phase -- no Playwright/Selenium, no new launcher. Its deliverable is a spawned detached browser process plus a one-line report, not a written document, so output_path points at the ADW's own runtime data directory rather than readable_documents/reports. Read is for the --message-out file; no Write/Edit, since this agent changes nothing in the repo.
